findings: Token creation, deadline ticks, and release are now measured directly at their own executable pins, not inferred from the diagnostic getter.
In BOTH sessions the score beat and mood were already null at release entry (beatBefore=null, moodBefore=null): the leadership drop happened at/near token creation, not at the deadline.

scheduleStoryAuthority (mMA) was NEVER invoked in either session. In the pause session the single MOOD_LY_CALLS_mMA hit shows transition=false / noop=true, so the guarded callsite did not fire. There is therefore NO measured 4.5s complementary authority/bed automation in these captures: no atTime, no endpoints, no bed callback invocation.

The observed token lifetime exceeds the exact 5s cap in both sessions (5.0894s / 5.0927s; overshoot 89.5ms / 92.8ms) measured at the RELEASE pin itself, not at a diagnostic read. The first over-cap deadline tick occurs at 5.0093s / 5.0012s and release entry follows ~80-92ms later.

A real Escape keypress at live token age ~1.1s did NOT cancel the token: no live cancel hit occurred and the token still ran to its full ~5.09s release. Both ngA cancel hits in each session are pre-token (mono ~5.2s, live=false, reasonArg=null).
cancel logpoint is NOT age-gated, so a ~1s cancellation could not have been filtered by the 4.8s sparse rule; the sparse rule applies only to the per-frame deadline pin.
